title: Debating Skills — Introduction
skills: identify foundational skills used in effective debate
present claims clearly and support them with relevant evidence
listen to and respond to opposing viewpoints
use organized reasoning, rebuttal, and respectful delivery in discussion
alignment_note: Introduces foundational debating skills, including clear argument development, evidence use, listening, rebuttal, and effective delivery. Supports oral argumentation, public speaking, critical thinking, civil discourse, and evidence-based discussion across high school English courses.
